title: Fix Trinity Rewrite Lhs Surface ReferenceError
description: Fix ReferenceError buildPuzzle2dSceneDescriptorFromFixture is not defined in TrinityRewriteLhsSurfaceHost
summary: Added puzzle-2d-react and forms-react imports to TrinityPlayHost so the trinity-rewrite virtual slice is self-contained when embedded from S/OS dev. Stripped those imports from the Trinity host when concatenating S play hosts to avoid duplicates. Removed duplicate buildPuzzle2dSceneDescriptorFromFixture entry in Puzzle2dPlayHost imports.
